question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Facebook is the most popular (a) ------- network service. These web-based platforms help people connect and interact through the Internet. They allow users with similar interests to stay connected across (b) -------. One key reason for their rapid growth is that most services are (c) ------- of charge, requiring only a small payment to the Internet provider. Users can create public profiles and view others’, making it easy to (d) ------- themselves to the world. Social networks also allow uploading photos and videos and even posting (e) ------- entries. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) social; (b) borders; (c) free; (d) present; (e) blog; ● ●
